class.name: NetwTransport
class.brief_description: A transport a game subclasses so its own [MultiplayerPeer] works with the connect plane.

method.name: _accepts_empty_address
method.description: Override to declare that an empty address means something to this transport, so a form accepts a blank field. [method accepts_empty_address] returns this, or [method accepts_empty_address_default] when nothing overrode it, which returns [code]false[/code].

method.name: _address_help
method.description: Override to return the sentence a form shows under the address field. [method address_help] returns this, or [method address_help_default] when nothing overrode it, which returns an empty string.

method.name: _address_label
method.description: Override to title the address field a Host or Add form draws for this transport: a server IP, a URL, a room id. [method address_label] returns this, or [method address_label_default] when nothing overrode it, which returns [code]"Address"[/code].

method.name: _address_placeholder
method.description: Override to return what a form shows in the empty address field. [method address_placeholder] returns this, or [method address_placeholder_default] when nothing overrode it, which returns an empty string.

method.name: _adopt
method.description: Override to receive [param peer] once it has been built or elevated onto this transport, so the transport can hold what it needs to service it afterward. Has no default: the base implementation does nothing.

method.name: _browse
method.description: Override to list what this peer class can reach and report it with [method publish_targets]. Called by [method NetwMultiplayer.endpoint_refresh] on a transport whose [method _can_browse] returns [code]true[/code], and returned as many times as the listing changes rather than once: a lobby service that pushes updates publishes again from [method _poll]. The listing this publishes REPLACES this peer class's rows, and a row's browse id is stable per address, so republishing does not renumber what a browser has drawn.

method.name: _can_browse
method.description: Override to return whether this transport lists at all. [method can_browse] returns this, or [method can_browse_default] when nothing overrode it, which returns [code]false[/code]: a transport that only builds and probes is asked for no listing.

method.name: _can_host_here
method.description: Override and return [code]false[/code] when this process cannot host with the transport. [method can_host_here] returns this value or [method can_host_here_default].

method.name: _can_probe
method.description: Override to declare that a row of this peer class can be asked what is there without joining it, which is what [method NetwMultiplayer.endpoint_probe] needs. [method can_probe] returns this, or [method can_probe_default] when nothing overrode it, which returns [code]false[/code].

method.name: _cancel_peer_creation
method.description: Override to release whatever [method _make_peer] provisionally acquired for [param ticket] when the request is withdrawn before it delivered, either by [method NetwMultiplayer.transport_cancel_peer_creation] or by [method NetwMultiplayer.transport_unregister] withdrawing this transport. It is request-scoped cleanup and not [method _close], which tears down an adopted runtime instead. Has no default: the base implementation does nothing. A request whose work cannot be recalled keeps only enough state to discard the eventual result. Reporting it under a different ticket is a defect, and reporting it under this one is discarded.

method.name: _client_settings
_close
method.description: Override to release whatever this transport is holding when the session it was made for ends. Has no default: the base implementation does nothing.

method.name: _diagnostics
method.description: Override to return free-form transport state for [param peer_id], surfaced through [method NetwConnectHandle.diagnostics]. [method diagnostics] returns this, or [method diagnostics_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: _display_name
method.description: Override to name this transport for a Host or Add form's transport picker. [method display_name] returns this, or [method display_name_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: _host_settings
method.description: Override to return the fields a host form asks for, one entry per field, typed by its own value. It is what [constant NetwMultiplayer.TRANSPORT_PARAM_HOST_SETTINGS] returns and what [method NetwMultiplayer.transport_create_peer] reads back. A transport that overrides nothing offers no fields. Return settings used by [method _make_peer] while hosting. Include shared keys in both host and client settings.

method.name: _is_available
method.description: Override to gate this transport on the current platform. [method is_available] returns this, or [method is_available_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: _join_address
method.description: Override to return what another peer joins this host by, once hosting. [method join_address] returns this, or [method join_address_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: _make_peer
method.description: Override to build one peer for [param ticket], reporting it with [method deliver] or reporting an [enum @GlobalScope.Error] with [method fail]. [param mode] says which peer: [constant NetwMultiplayer.TRANSPORT_MODE_HOST] builds a server from [param settings] alone, and [constant NetwMultiplayer.TRANSPORT_MODE_CLIENT] builds a client joining [param address]. [method NetwMultiplayer.transport_create_peer] is what runs this; nothing calls it as a plain method. Has no default: the base implementation fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNCONFIGURED]. Report [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE] through [method fail] when a host bind failed because the port is taken, which is what a caller reads to decide that someone is already hosting here. Deliver a peer that is still connecting rather than waiting for it to connect: the assignment edge is what watches for the connection, and a peer that came alive before the session held it would have announced to nobody. [param ticket] identifies this request. Store it before the first [code]await[/code] so [method deliver] can match a delayed result to the request.

method.name: _make_probe_peer
method.description: Override to build the [MultiplayerPeer] [method probe_default] opens against [param address] to speak the stock probe protocol. [method make_probe_peer] returns this, or [method make_probe_peer_default] when nothing overrode it, which returns [code]null[/code].

method.name: _peer_class
method.description: Override to name the [MultiplayerPeer] class this transport owns, [code]&"ENetMultiplayerPeer"[/code] or a scripted peer's own [code]class_name[/code]. This is the key the transport book looks a transport up by. [method peer_class] returns this, or [method peer_class_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: _poll
method.description: Override to service this transport's carrier once per frame, before the plane reads anything off it. Has no default: the base implementation does nothing.

method.name: _probe
method.description: Override to return what a host at [param address] is without joining it, reporting the [NetwServerInfo] with [method deliver_probe] or an [enum @GlobalScope.Error] with [method fail]. [method probe_default] is the default result, opening [method make_probe_peer] and speaking the built-in probe protocol over it, and it is this seam's only route back to that stock behaviour, because a GDScript subclass cannot [code]super()[/code] into a [code]GDVIRTUAL[/code]. The default fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when [method make_probe_peer] returns [code]null[/code].

method.name: _recognizes_peer
method.description: Override to decide whether [param peer], built and assigned by hand rather than through this transport, still elevates onto it. Claiming a peer subclass this transport did not build, or rejecting a peer of the exact class it configures under some other condition, both go here. [method recognizes_peer] returns this, or [method recognizes_peer_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: _timeout_hint
method.description: Override to limit how long [method _make_peer] or [method _probe] may run before returning [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_TIMEOUT]. A negative value disables this timeout. The default is [code]5.0[/code].

method.name: accepts_empty_address
method.description: Returns [method _accepts_empty_address], or [method accepts_empty_address_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: accepts_empty_address_default
method.description: [code]false[/code]: an address is required.

method.name: address_help
method.description: Returns [method _address_help], or [method address_help_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: address_help_default
method.description: An empty string.

method.name: address_label
method.description: Returns [method _address_label], or [method address_label_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: address_label_default
method.description: [code]"Address"[/code].

method.name: address_placeholder
method.description: Returns [method _address_placeholder], or [method address_placeholder_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: address_placeholder_default
method.description: An empty string.

method.name: can_browse
method.description: Returns [method _can_browse], or [method can_browse_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: can_browse_default
method.description: [code]false[/code]: a transport lists nothing unless it says otherwise.

method.name: can_host_here
method.description: Returns [method _can_host_here], or [method can_host_here_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: can_host_here_default
method.description: [code]true[/code].

method.name: can_probe
method.description: Returns [method _can_probe], or [method can_probe_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: can_probe_default
method.description: [code]false[/code]: a transport probes nothing unless it says otherwise.

method.name: client_settings
method.description: Returns [method _client_settings], or [method client_settings_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: client_settings_default
method.description: An empty [Dictionary]: a join form offers no fields until a transport names some.

method.name: deliver
method.description: Reports [param peer] as what [method _make_peer] built for [param ticket]. Call it once, from any frame. A second call, or a call under a ticket this instance is no longer building, does nothing.

method.name: deliver_probe
method.description: Reports [param info] as what [method _probe] found at the address [param ticket] named. Call it once, from any frame.

method.name: diagnostics
method.description: Returns [method _diagnostics] for [param peer_id], or [method diagnostics_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: diagnostics_default
method.description: An empty [Dictionary], ignoring [param peer_id].

method.name: display_name
method.description: Returns [method _display_name], or [method display_name_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: display_name_default
method.description: [code]"Generic"[/code].

method.name: fail
method.description: Reports that [param ticket] cannot finish, with [param error] as the reason and [param message] as the sentence behind it. Call it once, from any frame, in place of [method deliver] or [method deliver_probe].

method.name: host_settings
method.description: Returns [method _host_settings], or [method host_settings_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: host_settings_default
method.description: An empty [Dictionary]: a host form offers no fields until a transport names some.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [method _is_available], or [method is_available_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: is_available_default
method.description: [code]true[/code].

method.name: join_address
method.description: Returns [method _join_address], or [method join_address_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: join_address_default
method.description: An empty [String].

method.name: make_probe_peer
method.description: Returns [method _make_probe_peer] for [param address], or [method make_probe_peer_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: make_probe_peer_default
method.description: [code]null[/code], ignoring [param address]. [method probe_default] reads this as a transport that does not probe at all.

method.name: peer_class
method.description: Returns [method _peer_class], or [method peer_class_default] when nothing overrode it. [method NetwConnectHandle.transports] lists every class currently returned this way, in registration order.

method.name: peer_class_default
method.description: An empty [StringName], which the transport book never matches to a live peer.

method.name: peer_class_of
method.description: The class [param peer] would elevate under: its native class name, or a scripted peer's own [code]class_name[/code]. [method recognizes_peer_default] compares this against [method peer_class].

method.name: probe_default
method.description: The stock probe: opens [method make_probe_peer] against [param address], speaks the built-in probe protocol over it, and reports the [NetwServerInfo] it returns. Fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when [method make_probe_peer] returns [code]null[/code]. This is [method _probe]'s only route back to stock behaviour, since a GDScript subclass cannot [code]super()[/code] into a [code]GDVIRTUAL[/code].

method.name: publish_targets
recognizes_peer
method.description: Returns [method _recognizes_peer] for [param peer], or [method recognizes_peer_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: recognizes_peer_default
method.description: [code]true[/code] when [method peer_class_of] applied to [param peer] returns the same [StringName] as [method peer_class].

method.name: report
method.description: Forwards [param step], [param message] and [param ratio] to the progress [Callable] [param ticket] was created with. Does nothing once [param ticket] has settled, so a slow provider cannot report progress behind a result the caller already has.

method.name: timeout_hint
method.description: Returns [method _timeout_hint], or [method timeout_hint_default] when nothing overrode it.

method.name: timeout_hint_default
method.description: [code]5.0[/code] seconds.

members.member: The session this instance was made for. Read-only, and [code]null[/code] on a prototype.
